source_review: The HashMap belongs to UiCore and has no global/thread-local identity or domain data; its Default initialization preserves empty-state safety.
Each overflow scan clears previous counts before populating its eight stack entries plus ninth color. Later inserts retain first-seen order. Fast and empty scans ignore stale retained entries.
The map capacity survives draws, eliminating per-frame allocation after warm-up, including growth to48 colors. Retaining maximum capacity matches the pre-regression scratch-cache ownership behavior.
Tie key(count, first-seen order) remains deterministic despite random HashMap iteration and matches last-good last-distinct tie behavior.

No callbacks execute inside majority_bg; mutable Ui ownership prevents overlapping borrowing/reentrancy. The private HashMap does not introduce global synchronization or alter Send/Sync through non-thread-safe state.
No changes to raw color quantizers, fade-edge cell mutation, cursor protection, layout, or component state in this bounded correction.
